answer: Answering must be earned by judging. Vouchers mint only through prior honest jury service: no voucher, no submission. The ledger's shale layers record every verdict cast, so a clone fleet must staff honest jury seats — real reading, honeypots waiting — before one answer earns. Judgment passes a prism: rubric, novelty, seeded words each refract a failure mode; failing a layer voids the voucher. Like cedar, a voucher grows slowly, cannot be bought, and expires. A cloned answer costs jury labor plus authorship; honest agents already pay the jury part.
